items.title_zh: 微软 GitHub 副总裁开源“GPU 任务管理器”工具，让显卡占用一目了然
items.title_en: Microsoft/GitHub VP open-sources gputaskman, a per-process GPU monitor
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，微软资深开发者、微软与 GitHub 副总裁斯科特 · 汉塞尔曼（Scott Hanselman）最新发布名为 gputaskman 的开源 GPU 监控工具， 帮助用户看清究竟是哪个程序在“吃”显卡资源。 汉塞尔曼长期活跃于 .NET、开源、开发者社区和 AI 开发工具领域，拥有 30 多年的编程经验，曾在 Intel、Nike、STEP Technology 等公司工作，目前在 Microsoft / GitHub 担任副总裁兼技术成员。 IT之家曾于今年 4 月报道， 汉塞尔曼推出 PeekDesktop 工具 ，成功将 macOS Sonoma 系统的“点击壁纸显示桌面”功能移植到 Windows 10 和 Windows 11 平台。 科技媒体 NeoWin 指出，长期以来 Windows 任务管理器虽能显示 GPU 使用率、温度等总体数据，也能在“详细信息”页开启按进程查看显存，却难以解释各进程具体在做什么。英伟达的 GPU 活动监视器同样只列出正在占用显卡的程序，信息仍较有限。gputaskman 试图补上这一缺口。 gputaskman 工具可按进程展示 GPU 使用率、显存占用、温度、功耗、时钟频率、编码器与解码器活动以及 PCIe 流量等数据。对于正在本地运行大语言模型的用户，它还能识别 LLM 进程，并显示模型、运行时、模型权重…
items.summary_en: Scott Hanselman, a Microsoft/GitHub vice president, has released gputaskman, an open-source tool that breaks down GPU usage per process, covering utilization, VRAM, temperature, power, clocks, encoder/decoder activity and PCIe traffic. It can also identify local LLM processes and show which model, runtime and weights are in use, filling a gap left by Windows Task Manager and Nvidia's activity monitor.
items.why_zh: GPU 资源争用往往难以定位，进程级的可视化对在本地跑大模型的开发者尤为实用。
items.why_en: GPU contention is hard to diagnose, and per-process visibility is especially useful for developers running LLMs locally.

items.title_zh: 西门子医疗与阿里达摩院签约：加速普及 AI“一扫多筛”，一次 CT 扫描早期发现癌症等重大疾病
items.title_en: Siemens Healthineers and Alibaba DAMO tie up to scale AI 'one-scan, multi-screen' early detection
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，11 月 6 日，在上海举行的第九届中国国际进口博览会上，西门子医疗与阿里巴巴达摩院签署战略合作协议，计划将达摩院首创的“一扫多筛”AI 技术与西门子医疗的影像设备、临床应用相结合，助力癌症和心血管病等重大疾病的早期发现。 据介绍，达摩院自研基于平扫 CT + AI 的“一扫多筛”技术， 即用 AI 识别 CT 影像中肉眼难以分辨的多种细微病灶 ，先后突破消化肿瘤影像筛查、主动脉夹层预警等国际重大医学难题，相关成果登上《科学》（Science）、《自然 · 医学》（Nature Medicine）等顶级期刊，进入国家药监局的创新医疗器械审评绿色通道，并获美国 FDA“突破性医疗器械”认定。 IT之家获悉，双方拟依托西门子医疗的医疗影像设备和临床应用资源， 引入达摩院医疗 AI 模型，推广用一次 CT 扫描早期发现胰腺癌、胃癌、肠癌、食管癌、肝癌等高致死癌症，以及主动脉夹层、肺动脉栓塞等心血管危急重症 。 此外，基于被业内视作近十年最重大技术突破的光子计数 CT，双方也将联合瑞金医院等顶尖机构开展系列 AI 研究、临床验证和应用推广，探索用更低剂量发现更为细微的早期病灶。 据悉，达摩院 AI 此前已为全球 10 个国家和地区的医疗机构提供超 5000 万人次服务。
items.summary_en: Siemens Healthineers and Alibaba's DAMO Academy signed a strategic cooperation at the China International Import Expo to pair DAMO's 'one-scan, multi-screen' AI with Siemens imaging hardware and clinical workflows. The technology uses plain CT plus AI to flag subtle lesions, with published results in Science and Nature Medicine, and is meant to enable single-CT early detection of pancreatic, gastric, colorectal, esophageal and liver cancers as well as aortic dissection and pulmonary embolism. The partners will also study photon-counting CT with Ruijin Hospital.
items.why_zh: 若一次平扫 CT 能同时筛查多种致命疾病，将显著改变基层筛查的成本结构与可及性。
items.why_en: If a single plain CT can screen for multiple deadly conditions, it could reshape the cost and reach of early-detection programs.

items.title_zh: 腾讯发布 Hy4 模型，强化视觉推理与 AI 安全
items.title_en: Tencent launches Hy4 model to boost visual reasoning, AI safety
items.summary_zh: 据 digitimes 报道，腾讯推出 Hy4 模型，重点提升视觉推理能力与 AI 安全水平。报道未披露该模型的参数规模、具体评测成绩、上线时间表与开放方式，更多技术细节有待官方公布。从标题关注点看，腾讯同时在多模态推理能力和模型安全治理两个方向上推进新版本迭代。
items.summary_en: Tencent launches Hy4 model to boost visual reasoning, AI safety digitimes
items.why_zh: 视觉推理与安全能力同步升级，反映头部厂商在多模态落地与模型治理上的双重竞争。
items.why_en: Pairing visual reasoning with safety updates reflects the twin race in multimodal capability and model governance among major vendors.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek带火稀疏计算，国产芯片公司加速突围：这公司又融近10亿
items.title_en: DeepSeek hype lifts sparse computing as a domestic chip firm raises nearly RMB 1 billion
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek带火稀疏计算，国产芯片公司加速突围：这公司又融近10亿 搜狐网
items.summary_en: A Sohu report says DeepSeek has drawn attention to sparse computing, spurring domestic chip companies to push ahead, with one unnamed company raising close to RMB 1 billion in a new round. The report did not identify the company, investors, round or valuation.
items.why_zh: 稀疏计算被视为降低大模型推理成本的关键路径，资本动向反映国产算力生态的竞争节奏。
items.why_en: Sparse computing is seen as a key lever for cutting LLM inference costs, and funding flows signal the pace of China's chip ecosystem race.

items.title_zh: 默认禁用：微软 Win11 新版搜索 2026 年底前将集成 Copilot AI 可选功能
items.title_en: Windows 11's new search adds Copilot as an opt-in, off-by-default feature
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，科技媒体 Windows Central 昨日（11 月 5 日）发布博文，报道称 在 Windows 11 全新搜索体验中 ，微软计划今年年底前通过可选加入（opt-in）方式， 整合 Copilot AI 技能。 IT之家援引博文介绍，与此前备受争议的“Ask Copilot”不同，这次 Copilot 集成默认情况下处于禁用状态，用户需要手动操作后才能启用，不希望使用 AI 助手的用户不会在搜索界面中看到相关入口。 根据微软的规划，全新 Windows 搜索界面将更注重本地体验：用户不仅能更准确地查找文件与应用，还能直接修改系统设置、打开应用、回复短信、预览图片和文件，并执行部分电脑操作。新界面减少了网页内容占比，并采用 Windows 原生 UI 框架，以带来更快、更流畅的使用感受。 在 Copilot 整合后，用户可以直接在任务栏搜索框中获得快速回答；若需要更深入地对话，也可从搜索界面跳转至完整版 Copilot 应用。微软表示，该功能将率先面向部分市场推出，随后逐步扩展。 该媒体指出，微软能否真正兑现“完全可选”的承诺，仍取决于后续推送范围、默认设置以及不同市场的落地方式。 相关阅读： 《 微软更新 Win11 26H2 26340.9843 预览版：重构搜索体验，增强 XBOX 游戏模式 》 《 微软 Win11 26H1 更新预览版：…
items.summary_en: Microsoft plans to add Copilot skills to the redesigned Windows 11 search as an opt-in feature that stays disabled by default, per Windows Central, unlike the earlier 'Ask Copilot' approach. The new search emphasizes local results, settings changes, app launching, message replies and file previews, with less web content and native Windows UI, and will roll out first in select markets.
items.why_zh: 默认关闭的 AI 集成是对此前用户反弹的直接回应，也将成为衡量系统级 AI 是否真正可选的试金石。
items.why_en: An off-by-default AI integration answers earlier user backlash and becomes a test case for whether OS-level AI can be truly optional.

items.title_zh: webAI 开源 TwIL-8B 推理模型：聚焦数学与编程，长板表现优于 Gemma 4 31B
items.title_en: webAI open-sources TwIL-8B, a math and coding specialist that beats Gemma 4 31B on its strengths
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，专注于本地小型专业模型的人工智能实验室 webAI 当地时间本月 4 日推出了 TwIL-8B 推理模型。 这一模型基于 IBM Granite-4.2-8B， 针对数学、代码、指令跟踪工作负载进行优化 ，以其非商业许可协议开源。 webAI 表示，TwIL-8B 在 MATH-500、AIME 2025 两项高等数学基准测试上拥有参与比较的模型中的最佳成绩，甚至强于尺寸数倍的谷歌 Gemma 4 31B；同时其 LiveCodeBench 成绩也是同组最佳；此外其 IFBench 指令执行测试表现与 Gemma 4 12B 持平。 webAI 宣称 TwIL-8B 的 推理能力在其长板达到前沿模型的 88~93% ，能在很多情况下降低 AI 使用成本。不过，该模型的知识储备有限，并非通用模型。 参考 https://huggingface.co/webAI-Official/TwIL-8B
items.summary_en: webAI released TwIL-8B, an open-source reasoning model built on IBM Granite-4.2-8B and tuned for math, code and instruction following under a non-commercial license. The lab claims top scores among compared models on MATH-500 and AIME 2025 — ahead of the much larger Gemma 4 31B — plus best-in-group LiveCodeBench results and IFBench parity with Gemma 4 12B, while acknowledging limited world knowledge.
items.why_zh: 小参数专业模型在特定任务上逼近甚至超越大模型，说明“够用即可”的本地部署路线在成本上越来越有说服力。
items.why_en: A small specialized model matching larger ones on targeted tasks strengthens the case for cheaper, local 'good-enough' deployment.

items.title_zh: 美国橡树岭国家实验室携手 IBM、AMD 推出量子纠错协同设计平台
items.title_en: Oak Ridge, IBM and AMD launch a quantum error-correction co-design platform
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，美国能源部资助的橡树岭国家实验室旗下量子科学中心当地时间本月 5 日宣布携手 IBM 与 AMD 共同发布全新量子纠错协同设计平台。 这一平台的首个部署方案 集成了 IBM 的量子计算机和橡树岭实验室基于 AMD CPU 与 GPU 的 HPC 系统 。AMD 的硬件可为量子纠错、解码优化、软件编排提供经典算力基础。 研究人员可在该协同设计平台上评估经典计算和量子计算的紧密集成，从而 推动量子纠错研究的发展 ，加速容错量子计算“硬操作”的增长，达成到 2028 年底实现 100 个逻辑量子比特运行 10 万次“硬操作”的目标。
items.summary_en: The Oak Ridge Quantum Science Center, IBM and AMD unveiled a quantum error-correction co-design platform that links an IBM quantum computer with Oak Ridge's AMD-based HPC systems, using AMD CPUs and GPUs for decoding, optimization and orchestration. The partners aim to advance error correction toward 100 logical qubits performing 100,000 'hard operations' by the end of 2028.
items.why_zh: 纠错是通往实用量子计算的关键瓶颈，经典 HPC 与量子硬件的协同设计正成为加速路线。
items.why_en: Error correction is the key bottleneck to useful quantum computing, making classical-quantum co-design a critical accelerator.

items.title_zh: 论文比较 AI 演化路径：达尔文式、拉马克式与智能体自主导向
items.title_en: Adapting the Process of Adaptation: Darwinian, Lamarckian, and Agent-Directed Evolution in AI
items.summary_zh: 一篇新发表于 arXiv 的论文提出理论框架，比较 AI 在环境变化之后的三种演化路径：依赖自然选择的达尔文式演化、加入可继承学习成果的拉马克式演化，以及由智能体自行主导的演化。研究关注的核心问题是：当 AI 智能体能够修改并评估自身行为时，其改进速度能有多快，以及这种自我改进如何保持在安全范围内。论文以此为理解 AI 自我演化能力与安全边界提供统一的分析视角。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.07048v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Evolution has shaped intelligence for billions of years. Artificial intelligence (AI) now raises a striking possibility: intelligence may begin to direct its own evolution. As AI agents become capable of modifying and evaluating their own behavior, how quickly could they improve, and how can that improvement remain safe? We develop a theoretical framework comparing Darwinian, Lamarckian, and agent-directed evolution following environmental change. Darwinian evolution relies on natural selection, Lamarckian evolution adds inherited learning, and a…
items.why_zh: 当智能体开始参与自身演化，改进速度与可控性之间的张力将成为 AI 安全的核心议题。
items.why_en: Once agents shape their own evolution, the tension between speed of improvement and controllability becomes central to AI safety.

items.title_zh: FlashOffloading：面向长上下文 LLM 服务的低延迟 KV 缓存卸载
items.title_en: FlashOffloading: Low-Latency KV Cache Offloading for Long-Context LLM Serving
items.summary_zh: 在长上下文推理中，KV 缓存会随序列长度和并发数线性增长，很快触及高带宽内存（HBM）的容量上限，导致并发度上不去。把 KV 缓存卸载到主机 DRAM 可以释放 HBM、提升并发，但额外的缓存管理与主机到设备（H2D）加载开销会抬高推理延迟，使“高并发”难以转化为有效吞吐。arXiv 新论文提出 FlashOffloading，一种面向主机侧的低延迟 KV 缓存卸载方案，目标是在释放 HBM 空间的同时把卸载带来的延迟代价压到较低水平（原文摘要在此处截断，具体机制未完整披露）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.07542v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In large language model (LLM) serving systems, the key-value (KV) cache grows linearly with sequence length and concurrency, so long-context inference easily hits the high-bandwidth memory (HBM) capacity wall and results in low concurrency. Offloading the KV cache to host dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) frees HBM space and raises concurrency, but the additional cache management and host-to-device (H2D) load overhead inflates inference latency, higher concurrency fails to translate into effective throughput. We present FlashOffloading, a host-…
items.why_zh: 长上下文服务的内存瓶颈直接决定推理成本与可承载并发，低延迟卸载是把长上下文真正跑起来的关键工程问题。
items.why_en: Memory pressure is the binding constraint on long-context serving, so low-latency KV offloading directly shapes inference cost and achievable concurrency.

items.title_zh: 搭建自己的 AI 工作栈：一家小型软件公司的自托管实践
items.title_en: Create Your Own Work Stack: Deploying Self-hosted AI and Tooling in a Tech Startup
items.summary_zh: 自托管 AI 常被宣传为降低推理成本、增强可控性的手段，但部署本身也会带来新的成本。文章报告了小型软件公司 Grayhat Developers 在其 AI 密集型开发流程中部署混合 AI 栈的经验。最初的动机是对抗不断上涨的商业 AI 开支：使用 Claude/Codex 每月约 325 美元，记录的 token 用量超过 259.3 亿。团队尝试用本地开源模型替代商业编码智能体，但（原文摘要在此处截断），整体经验说明自托管的收益与运维负担需要一起算账。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.08116v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Self-hosting AI is often presented as a way to reduce inference costs and increase control, but deployment introduces its own costs. We report our experience deploying a hybrid AI stack at Grayhat Developers, a small software company with an AI-intensive development workflow. Our initial motivation was to counter the growing cost of commercial AI usage: Claude/Codex incurred approximately \$325 per month, with more than 25.93 billion recorded tokens. We experimented with local open-source models as replacements for commercial coding agents, but a…
items.why_zh: 它为中小团队提供了一个真实的成本与运维权衡样本：自托管未必更便宜，但值得先把这笔账算清楚。
items.why_en: It offers a grounded cost-and-operations case study for small teams weighing self-hosted AI against commercial APIs.

items.title_zh: 在异构认知与生物医学知识图谱上评测大模型：图接地对多跳推理与幻觉的作用
items.title_en: Benchmarking Large Language Models on Heterogeneous Cognitive and Biomedical Knowledge Graphs: The Role of Graph Grounding in Multi-Hop Reasoning and Hallucination Mitigation
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型已越来越多地用于生物医学与认知神经科学，但它们在异构知识图谱（KG）上能否可靠推理仍不清楚。研究对五款模型（GPT-5.1、Gemini 2.0 Pro、Llama 3、Qwen、BioGPT）在五个知识图谱（DrugBank、NeuroSynth、Cognitive Atlas、Brain Map、GDPKG）上进行了基准测试，并构建多层级查询数据集，在“图接地”与“非图接地”两种条件下评估推理深度与事实准确性。标注者间一致性达到较高水平（Cohen's kappa 显示为显著一致），摘要其余部分在原文中被截断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.08315v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used in biomedical and cognitive neuroscience, but their ability to reason reliably over heterogeneous knowledge graphs (KGs) remains unclear. We benchmark five LLMs (GPT-5.1, Gemini 2.0 Pro, Llama 3, Qwen, and BioGPT) across five KGs: DrugBank, NeuroSynth, Cognitive Atlas, Brain Map, and GDPKG. We introduce a multitier query dataset to evaluate reasoning depth and factual accuracy under KG-aware (graph-grounded) and KG-agnostic conditions. Inter-annotator agreement was substantial, with Cohen's kappa…
items.why_zh: 在高风险科学领域，“把答案接到知识图谱上”是否真能压住幻觉，需要可复现的量化证据而非直觉。
items.why_en: In high-stakes scientific domains, whether graph grounding actually curbs hallucination needs measurable, reproducible evidence.

items.title_zh: AI4Math 淘金热 II：AI 参与的数学证明有哪些可辨识特征？
items.title_en: The Gold Rush in AI4Math, II: What are signatures of AI-assisted Proofs?
items.summary_zh: AI 在数学中的使用日益增多，随之而来的问题是：能否把“AI 实质性参与证明”与“仅用 AI 辅助写作”区分开并被检测出来。研究以历史 arXiv 论文、近期披露实质性使用 AI 的论文以及 OpenAI 发布的文稿作为经验基础，但面临三重挑战：缺少匹配的病例-对照样本、AI 使用披露可能不完整、以及缺少现成可用的、能捕捉 AI 参与信号的特征。为此作者构建了五项……（原文摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.08412v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The growing use of AI in mathematics raises a question: can we detect AI involvement in proofs, separately from AI assistance with writing? Historical arXiv papers, recent papers disclosing substantive AI use, and manuscripts released by OpenAI provide a rich empirical basis for studying this question. However, several challenges remain: lack of matched case-control pairs; potential incompleteness of disclosure; and lack of ready-to-use features designed to capture signals of AI involvement in proofs. To address these challenges, we construct fiv…
items.why_zh: 如果 AI 参与的证明无法被识别，学术诚信审查与署名规范就缺少可操作的技术依据。
items.why_en: Without detectable signatures, norms for attribution and integrity in AI-assisted mathematics have no technical footing.

items.title_zh: 把基准当软件来维护：Terminal-Bench 与持续基准的必要性
items.title_en: Benchmarks as Software: Terminal-Bench and the Case for Continuous Benchmarks
items.summary_zh: 编码智能体是目前大模型最具经济影响的落地形态之一，可靠评测因此愈发重要。但即便是发布时经过仔细验证的基准也会过时：随着模型变强，它们可能给出被现有验证器误判为错误的合法解法；评测基础设施的改动也可能让任务与测试中暗含的假设失效。作者把这类缺陷的累积称为“基准维护债”，即基准分数与其本想衡量的能力之间不断扩大的差距，并以 Terminal-Bench 为例，主张把基准当作需要持续维护的软件来对待。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.08417v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coding agents are among the most economically consequential deployments of LLMs to date, making reliable evaluation increasingly important. Yet even benchmarks that are carefully validated at release can become stale. As models improve, they can discover valid solutions that existing verifiers reject, while changes to evaluation infrastructure can invalidate assumptions embedded in tasks and tests. We call the resulting accumulation of defects benchmark maintenance debt: a growing gap between benchmark scores and the capabilities they are intende…
items.why_zh: 基准失真会直接误导模型选型与采购决策，把评测质量问题定义为维护债，使其进入工程预算与流程。
items.why_en: Stale benchmarks distort model selection and procurement, and framing them as maintenance debt makes evaluation quality an engineering responsibility.

items.title_zh: ReproBridge：把可复现性内建到机器学习研究制品中
items.title_en: ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
items.summary_zh: 复现机器学习实验，需要从散落在论文、开源代码与配套制品中的信息里重建整个流程；对编码智能体而言，复现能否成功往往取决于它们能否补全缺失细节，而不只取决于已发布的制品本身。作者提出的问题是：把恢复出来的流程与决策记录下来，是否能提升后续的独立复现效果？为此他们定义了一套标准化制品设计，包含精炼后的代码库、环境配置、实验启动器以及复现相关的说明材料（原文摘要在该处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.08452v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifacts alone. We ask whether preserving recovered procedures and decisions improves subsequent independent reproduction. We define a standardized artifact design comprising a refined codebase, environment setup, experiment launchers, and a reproduction gui…
items.why_zh: 把复现知识显式沉淀进制品，比每次依赖智能体去“猜”缺失细节更可靠，也更利于规模化复用。
items.why_en: Making reproduction knowledge explicit in artifacts is more reliable and scalable than having agents guess at missing details each time.

items.title_zh: 一个描述人机认知协同演化的极简动力学模型
items.title_en: A minimal dynamical model of human-AI cognitive coevolution
items.summary_zh: 生成式 AI 的快速普及引出一个问题：普遍性的认知外包（cognitive offloading）是否会导致人类在无辅助状态下的推理能力出现可测量的、甚至不可逆的下降。作者基于 Cattell-Horn-Carroll 理论中流体智力（Gf）与晶体智力（Gc）的区分，构建了一个现象学动力学模型：从认知老化研究中使用的离散时间双变量潜变量变化分数（BLCS）形式出发，推导其连续时间线性对应形式，并引入一个快速的第三项（原文摘要在此处截断）。该框架把这场争论转化为可以被形式化推演的假设。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.06928v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The rapid deployment of generative AI raises the question of whether pervasive cognitive offloading drives a measurable, potentially irreversible decline in unassisted human reasoning. We examine this question with a phenomenological dynamical model based on the Cattell-Horn-Carroll distinction between fluid intelligence ($G_f$) and crystallized intelligence ($G_c$). Starting from the discrete-time Bivariate Latent Change Score formalism used in cognitive-aging research, we derive its continuous-time linear counterpart and introduce a fast thir…
items.why_zh: “AI 是否让人变笨”的争论长期停留在直觉层面，动力学模型把它变成了可检验、可推演的假设。
items.why_en: A dynamical model turns the intuition-level debate over AI-induced cognitive decline into testable hypotheses.

items.title_zh: KG-AST：用预算化测试选择与 AI 缺陷审查降低 CI/CD 成本
items.title_en: KG-AST for Cheaper CI/CD: Budgeted Test Selection and AI Bug Review
items.summary_zh: 持续集成与 AI 辅助评审对每一次提交都投入相同预算，但真正引入缺陷的提交只是少数。KG-AST 依据 git 历史与代码图特征，在跑重型测试或做 AI 评审之前先给每次提交打风险分，让预算优先流向高风险提交，并且只把改动周边的图切片交给 AI 评审者。在 11 种语言、155 个开源项目上，一个在其他项目上训练出的单一跨语言模型即可完成排序：只对风险最高的 20% 提交做重型测试，就能覆盖 49%–64% 的引入缺陷提交（原文摘要在此处截断）。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.06950v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Continuous integration and AI-assisted review spend the same budget on every commit, although few commits introduce bugs. We study KG-AST, which scores each commit risk from git history and code-graph features before heavy tests or AI review run, so the budget goes to the riskiest commits first, and which hands the AI reviewer only a graph slice around the change. On 155 open-source projects in 11 languages, a single cross-language model trained on other projects ranks commits so that heavy testing of the riskiest 20% covers 49-64% of bug-intro…
items.why_zh: 在提交量大的团队中，把有限的计算与审查预算集中到高风险改动上，是一条可量化、不牺牲质量的降本路径。
items.why_en: Concentrating scarce compute and review budget on the riskiest commits is a quantifiable way to cut CI cost without sacrificing quality.

items.title_zh: 大模型，小收益：冻结预测模型作为 MONSTER 分类器
items.title_en: Big Models, Small Gains: Frozen Forecasters as Classifiers on MONSTER
items.summary_zh: 该研究评估预测基础模型能否作为冻结特征提取器用于时间序列分类。作者在六个大型数据集上对 Reverso 和 Chronos-Bolt 进行受控基准测试，并与无需预训练的强分类器比较，重点考察在标注数据稀缺时预训练表示是否仍提供额外信息。标题“Big Models, Small Gains”暗示这类大模型带来的提升可能有限。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.06988v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Forecasting foundation models are increasingly used as frozen feature extractors for time series classification, but it remains unclear whether their pretrained representations offer an advantage over strong classifiers that do not require pretraining. This raises an important question: do these representations provide useful information beyond what the model architecture alone can capture, particularly when labelled data are scarce? We present a controlled benchmarking of two forecasting models, Reverso and Chronos-Bolt, on six large datasets…
items.why_zh: 它直接检验“冻结基础模型特征是否值得用”这一时间序列分类中的关键假设。
items.why_en: It directly tests a key assumption in time-series classification: whether frozen foundation-model features are worth using.

items.title_zh: 用软提示调优让 LLM 评审器对齐人类标注策略
items.title_en: Adapting LLM Judges to Observed Human Annotation Policy through Soft Prompt Tuning
items.summary_zh: 研究关注用开源大模型作为聊天机器人回复的自动评审器。专有模型与人类标注一致率高但成本高、部署难，轻量开源评审器则一致性较低。作者在 FairBotBench 上训练软提示，检验软提示调优能否让开源 LLM 评审器更贴近人类标注策略，从而提升自动评估的可靠性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.07126v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly employed as automated judges for evaluating chatbot responses. While proprietary models can achieve high agreement with human annotators, they remain costly and difficult to deploy in practical settings. Lightweight open-source LLM judges provide an attractive alternative but typically exhibit lower agreement with human ratings. In this paper, we investigate whether soft prompt tuning can align open-source LLM judges more closely with human annotation policy. We train soft prompts on the FairBotBenc…
items.why_zh: 若奏效，可在低成本下获得更接近人类标准的自动评审，降低对昂贵专有模型的依赖。
items.why_en: If effective, it could enable low-cost automated judging that better matches human standards and reduces reliance on expensive proprietary models.

items.title_zh: 通往真实世界的最后一公里：以智能体原生原语作为可复用构建块
items.title_en: The Last Mile to the Real World: Agent-Native Primitives as Reusable Building Blocks for Solving Real-World Tasks
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，前沿模型即便配合专用执行框架，在真实世界基准上仍表现不足：Terminal-Bench 4.0 上 GPT-5.6 Sol 配合 Codex 解决 37.3% 任务，Claude Opus 5 配合 Claude Code 解决 51.8%。失败集中在“接触到资源”到“正确应用资源”的最后一公里，而现有方法把应用能力留给调用方，导致每个框架重复重建。作者提出智能体原生原语，作为可复用的构建块来弥补这一差距。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.07461v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: How can an agent handle a real-world task end to end? Frontier models with their own harnesses still fall short on real-world benchmarks: on Terminal-Bench 4.0, GPT-5.6 Sol with Codex resolves 37.3% of the tasks and Claude Opus 5 with Claude Code 51.8%. These tasks fail at the step from reaching a resource to applying it, which we call the last mile to the real world. Existing approaches put the resource within reach but leave the competence to apply it with the caller, so each harness rebuilds that competence. We introduce agent-native primiti…
items.why_zh: 它把智能体落地失败的关键定位到可复用的“应用能力”层，而非单纯模型能力。
items.why_en: It locates a key failure in real-world agent deployment at the reusable 'application competence' layer rather than raw model capability alone.

items.title_zh: 记忆陷阱：语言智能体从良性交互中过度泛化
items.title_en: The Memory Trap: Language Agents Overgeneralize from Benign Interactions
items.summary_zh: 语言智能体越来越多地用持久记忆跨会话记录用户偏好和流程。研究发现，来自良性交互的记忆可能在后续任务中引发不安全或不可靠行为，作者称之为“记忆陷阱”。他们在六种前沿模型（包括 Claude Sonnet、Opus、Fable 系列及 GPT-5.6）上比较有记忆和无记忆会话，并在自主性实验中考察模型对“跳过确认”等请求的处理，发现记忆会影响后续行为。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.07554v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Language agents increasingly use persistent memory to record user preferences and procedures across sessions. We show that memory from benign interactions can cause unsafe or unreliable behavior on later tasks. We call this failure the memory trap. To study this issue, we compare behavior in sessions with and without memory across six frontier models (including Claude Sonnet, Opus, and Fable models and GPT-5.6). We evaluate these models in a range of settings. First, in autonomy experiments, we find that requests to skip confirmation during low…
items.why_zh: 它提醒持久记忆并非越多越好，良性经验也可能被错误泛化并累积成安全风险。
items.why_en: It warns that persistent memory is not simply better with more data: benign experiences can be misgeneralized and accumulate into safety risks.

items.title_zh: 何时、何地、如何：表格基础模型的主动上下文学习
items.title_en: When, Where, How: Active In-Context Learning for Tabular Foundation Models
items.summary_zh: 表格基础模型（TFM）只能通过上下文中的已标注行来适应新任务，但现实场景中高质量标签获取成本高且依赖领域知识。论文把经典主动学习采集规则迁移到这一设定，研究随着冻结 TFM 获得更多上下文，多样性、预测不确定性和目标感知信息增益的价值如何变化。该工作围绕这些问题展开分析，目标是更高效地选择标注样本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.07886v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Tabular Foundation Models (TFMs) adapt to a new task only through the labeled rows in their context. However, labels are expensive to acquire in real-world scenarios due to the need for highly specific domain knowledge to ensure high-quality data. Active in-context learning transfers classical acquisition rules to this setting, in which the model that guides acquisition changes with every label added. We ask how the value of diversity, predictive uncertainty and target-aware information gain changes as a frozen TFM acquires more context. For th…
items.why_zh: 它关系到如何用更少标注让表格基础模型适配新任务，降低真实场景的数据成本。
items.why_en: It matters for adapting tabular foundation models with fewer labels and lowering data costs in real-world settings.

items.title_zh: 通过了却错了：API 迁移后 LLM 代码修复的静默失败
items.title_en: Accepted but Wrong: Silent Failures of LLM Code Repairs after API Migrations
items.summary_zh: 论文研究 API 或运行时迁移后，LLM 修复的代码可能顺利运行却返回错误结果，而常规测试输入上的发布检查仍会将其放行。作者开展预注册研究，覆盖 CPython、Node.js 和 SQLite 的 60 项有文档变更、共 73 个任务，并在真实运行时上按保留契约执行候选修复。结果显示，典型输入上的全断言闸门放行了 41.0% 的错误修复；根据发布说明编写的一条边缘输入可将该比例降至 6.5%，在 15 个未见集群上为 6.1%。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.08269v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: After a runtime or API migration, an LLM-repaired procedure can run cleanly yet return wrong results, and a release check on typical test inputs ships it. We report a preregistered study of 73 tasks covering 60 documented changes in CPython, Node.js and SQLite. Every candidate is executed on the real runtimes against withheld contracts. Over the complete repair space, the all-assertions gate on typical inputs released 0.410 of wrong repairs. One edge input written from the release note cut this to 0.065, and to 0.061 on 15 unseen clusters. Thre…
items.why_zh: 它揭示常规测试闸门会系统性漏放错误修复，说明迁移场景需要更强的契约与边缘用例验证。
items.why_en: It reveals that conventional test gates systematically let wrong repairs through, highlighting the need for stronger contract and edge-case validation after migrations.

items.title_zh: 诊断并改进大语言模型的概率推理
items.title_en: Diagnosing and Improving Probabilistic Reasoning in Large Language Models
items.summary_zh: 论文把大语言模型视为需要在明确决策成本下依据证据进行概率推理的决策助手。作者提出一个决策论框架，将模型的决策损失分解为两部分：从给定证据形成准确信念，以及把信念转化为优化给定效用函数的行动。借助已知真实标签的合成基准，他们用该分解刻画前沿与开源模型的概率推理表现，并据此诊断和改进模型决策。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.38005v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly proposed as decision assistants who must reason probabilistically from available evidence under explicit decision costs. We propose a decision-theoretic framework that decomposes LLMs' decision loss into two components: forming accurate beliefs from provided evidence and translating those beliefs into actions that optimize a provided utility function. Using a synthetic benchmark with known ground truth, we apply the decomposition to characterize probabilistic reasoning in frontier and open-sourced…
items.why_zh: 它把“信念对不对”和“行动选得对不对”拆开评估，有助于定位 LLM 在不确定性决策中的具体短板。
items.why_en: It separates whether beliefs are accurate from whether actions are well chosen, helping pinpoint specific weaknesses in LLM decision-making under uncertainty.

items.title_zh: 面向语言模型智能体系统的集合值路由：WildChat 基准与成本感知评估
items.title_en: Set-Valued Routing for Language-Model Agent Systems: A WildChat Benchmark and Cost-Aware Evaluation
items.summary_zh: 语言模型智能体系统需要先把自然语言请求映射到一个或多个专用智能体，再进入规划或工具执行。现有做法常把路由视为 top-1 选择，但组合式请求可能需要多种能力，不必要地派发也会增加成本。作者把固定目录路由表述为集合值语言理解问题，构建了覆盖 12 个能力定义智能体、包含 3,000 条 WildChat 提示的基准，并提供按智能体频率和路由基数平衡的可复现模式引导参考集。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.28925v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Language-model agent systems must map natural-language requests to one or more specialized agents before planning or tool execution. This decision is often treated as top-1 selection, although compositional requests can require several capabilities and unnecessary dispatch raises cost. We formulate fixed-catalog routing as set-valued language understanding and construct a benchmark of 3,000 WildChat prompts over 12 capability-defined agents. Reproducible schema-guided reference sets are balanced by agent frequency and route cardinality.…
items.why_zh: 它针对组合式请求和多能力派发的真实需求，推动路由从单选走向可控成本的集合预测。
items.why_en: It addresses compositional requests and multi-capability dispatch, moving routing from single-choice selection toward cost-aware set prediction.

items.title_zh: Eigenius：面向 AI 科学家的类型化知识图谱数据库
items.title_en: Eigenius: A Typed Knowledge-Graph DBMS with Epistemic Stratification and Institution-Mediated Reasoning
items.summary_zh: arXiv 论文提出 Eigenius——一个开源、带类型系统的知识图谱数据库管理系统（DBMS），面向借助 Model Context Protocol（MCP）自主开展研究的“AI 科学家”。作者认为，依靠临时脚本的系统无法支撑规模庞大、有状态且高度互联的证据，而要回答“你知道什么、你的依据（warranty）是什么”这一审计问题，就必须有统一内核。Eigenius 把类型系统、存储引擎与集成协议紧密耦合，并引入认知分层（epistemic stratification）与机构中介推理（institution-mediated reasoning）机制。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.04457v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: As "AI Scientists" emerge to drive research via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), systems relying on ephemeral scripts will fail. The sheer scale of stateful, interconnected evidence requires a machine-walkable warranty grounded in a purpose-built database architecture. Eigenius is an open-source, typed knowledge-graph DBMS built on a single premise: answering the audit question ("what do you know, and what is your warranty?") requires a unified kernel. By tightly coupling the type system, storage engine, and integration protocol, Eigen…
items.why_zh: 要让 AI 智能体成为可信的研究伙伴，知识存储必须可审计、可追溯，而不是一次性脚本。
items.why_en: For AI agents to be trustworthy research partners, their knowledge stores must be auditable and traceable rather than ephemeral scripts.

items.title_zh: 自动驾驶研究需要社区驱动的数据范式
items.title_en: Autonomous Driving Research Requires a Community-Driven Data Paradigm
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，自动驾驶已取得显著进展，近期 AI 突破甚至推动了商业部署并重塑城市出行，但距离“任何地点、任何时间、对任何人都能稳健运行”的普遍社会承诺仍很遥远。作者认为，这一差距不只是建模问题，更是当前数据范式的问题：研究过度依赖少数基准数据集，空间与场景覆盖有限，而社区实际上已集体产出大量数据（原文摘要此处截断）。他们因此呼吁转向社区驱动的数据范式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.08825v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Autonomous driving has made remarkable progress, with recent AI advances enabling commercial deployments that are reshaping urban mobility. Yet the field remains far from its universal social promise: autonomous systems that can operate robustly anywhere, anytime, for anyone. We posit that this gap is not merely a modeling problem, but a problem of the prevailing data paradigm. Current research relies heavily on a few benchmark datasets with limited spatial and scenario coverage, even though the community has collectively produced over…
items.why_zh: 数据覆盖而非模型结构，可能才是自动驾驶走向普适的关键瓶颈。
items.why_en: Data coverage, not model architecture, may be the key bottleneck for universal autonomous driving.

items.title_zh: 用固定与自适应惩罚监管自动驾驶出行运营商：多智能体强化学习方法
items.title_en: Regulating Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand Operators with Fixed and Adaptive Penalties: A Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning Approach
items.summary_zh: 论文研究如何用基于惩罚的监管来约束追求利润最大化的自动驾驶出行即服务（AMoD）运营商。这类运营商可能通过过高定价攫取消费者剩余，并把车辆调离利润较低的区域，造成这些区域服务不足。作者将监管建模为作用于“学习型运营商”的外层控制回路：固定惩罚的静态监管被表述为马尔可夫决策过程，并进一步提出自适应惩罚的多智能体强化学习方法，以抑制动态加价、改善区域服务可用性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.07122v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Profit-maximizing Autonomous Mobility-on-Demand (AMoD) operators may exploit consumer surplus through excessive prices and underserve less profitable regions by relocating vehicles away from them. We study how penalty-based regulation of an AMoD operator in a multimodal mobility system can limit surge pricing and improve regional service availability. We model regulation as an outer control loop that acts on a learning-based operator. Static regulation with fixed penalties is formulated as a Markov Decision Process for an operator that jointly co…
items.why_zh: 为算法定价的出行平台设计可落地的监管机制，提供了形式化框架与强化学习解法。
items.why_en: It offers a formal framework and RL-based solution for designing workable regulation of algorithmically priced mobility platforms.

items.title_zh: 声学异常检测助力提前识别钻头卡死
items.title_en: Acoustic Anomaly Detection for Early Identification of Drill Jamming
items.summary_zh: 面向工业 4.0 的预测性维护，论文提出用超声波传感器做声学异常检测，以便在数控（CNC）加工中提前识别“钻头卡死”这一关键故障——它会同时损害工件质量与刀具完整性。作者公开了一个数据集，包含来自 17 支钻头的时间域与频域声学特征，并对基于半监督自编码器的方法进行了基准评测，用以捕捉故障前兆模式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.07356v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In the context of Industry 4.0, predictive maintenance is essential to minimize unplanned downtime and ensure operational safety. In machining processes, drill jamming is a critical failure that compromises both workpiece quality and tool integrity. This work proposes an acoustic anomaly detection system using ultrasonic sensors to identify pre-failure patterns in Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machining. We release a public dataset of time- and frequency-domain acoustic features from 17 drills, and benchmark semi-supervised autoencoder-based n…
items.why_zh: 公开数据集加声学早期预警，可减少非计划停机与刀具损耗，推动预测性维护落地。
items.why_en: An open dataset plus acoustic early warning can cut unplanned downtime and tool damage, advancing predictive maintenance in practice.

items.title_zh: 机器学习性能指标：从混淆矩阵到校准、回归与不确定性的场景化指南
items.title_en: Performance metrics in machine learning: a scenario-based guide from the confusion matrix to calibration, regression and uncertainty
items.summary_zh: 这是一篇方法论教程，指出同一组预测在不同指标下可能得出不同结论。作者用受控场景说明类别比例（class prevalence）、决策阈值、聚合规则与软件实现约定如何影响结果；把 22 个混淆矩阵指标整理成按类别比例编码的“地图”，并设计 15 个场景覆盖二分类与多分类、打分区分度、概率校准、回归、不确定性与一致性检查。所有输入文件已公开，每个场景只变动一个因子。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.08048v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Performance metrics can yield different conclusions from the same predictions. This methodological tutorial explains the effects of class prevalence, decision thresholds, aggregation rules and software conventions through controlled scenarios. Twenty-two confusion-matrix metrics are organized in a prevalence-coded map. Fifteen scenarios cover binary and multi-class classification, score discrimination, probability calibration, regression, uncertainty and consistency checks. Inputs are fixed in released files, and one factor is varied in each scen…
items.why_zh: 提醒研究者指标选择本身就会改变结论，并提供了可复现的评估规范。
items.why_en: It warns that metric choice alone can change conclusions and provides a reproducible evaluation protocol.

items.title_zh: 分子表示的局限：现有分子嵌入模型未能捕捉图结构等信息
items.title_en: On the limitations of molecular representations
items.summary_zh: 论文系统考察分子表示（指纹与学习到的嵌入）的质量。这类表示是化学信息学与小分子机器学习中聚类、数据集划分、虚拟筛选等任务的主要输入，但其评估往往局限于狭窄基准任务上的下游模型表现。作者的实证调查发现，当前最先进的分子嵌入模型没有一个能捕捉图结构、三维信息等关键性质（摘要此处截断），暴露出表示评估方式的不足。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.08420v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Molecular representations such as fingerprints and learned embeddings play a central role in cheminformatics and small-molecule machine learning. They serve as the primary input for a diverse array of tasks, including clustering, dataset splitting, and virtual screening, yet their evaluation is often limited to downstream model performance on narrow benchmark tasks. We carried out a systematic investigation of the quality of molecular representations, finding that none of the state-of-the-art molecular embedding models capture graph structure, 3D…
items.why_zh: 分子表示是药物发现类模型的输入底座，其缺陷会向下游任务传导。
items.why_en: Molecular representations underpin drug-discovery models, so their blind spots propagate into downstream tasks.

items.title_zh: 值的前一个 token 才是关键：语言模型归纳检索的寻址机制
items.title_en: The Token Before the Value Is the Key
items.summary_zh: 论文研究语言模型中的归纳回路（induction circuits）：模型通过把查询与“该值之前那个 token”携带的信息匹配来取回数值。但这一“地址”如何形成、如何纳入上下文、又如何支持连续检索，仍不清楚。作者以混合语言模型作为可控实验平台，识别出“历史来源键”（historical source key）这一在局部准备与全局检索之间起因果作用的共同接口，并通过探针与恢复性干预，在受控模型、预训练的循环与滑动窗口混合模型以及已发布语言模型上验证了该接口。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.15545v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Induction circuits retrieve a value by matching a query to information carried from the token before that value. How this address forms, incorporates context, and supports sequential retrieval remains less clear. We use hybrid language models as a tractable testbed and identify the historical source key as a common causal interface between local preparation and global retrieval. Probes and restoration interventions connect this interface across controlled models, pretrained recurrent and sliding-window hybrids, and released language models. W…
items.why_zh: 揭示上下文检索的内部寻址机制，有助于理解和改进长上下文能力。
items.why_en: Understanding the internal addressing behind in-context retrieval can inform efforts to improve long-context capabilities.

items.title_zh: 用特征干扰统一解释 LLM 监督微调中的普遍能力退化
items.title_en: Unifying and Beyond the Theory of Pervasive Capability Degradation in LLM Post-training SFT from Feature Interference
items.summary_zh: 论文聚焦大语言模型后训练中的“普遍能力退化”（PCD）：监督微调（SFT）在让模型适配目标任务的同时，往往会侵蚀预训练阶段获得的通用能力。主流解释把原因归于宏观的分布漂移，缺乏微观层面的可操作性，使现有缓解方法缺少完整理论基础。作者基于叠加（superposition）下的特征干扰，提出一个自下而上的几何理论来统一解释 PCD，并在此基础上进一步拓展。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.05003v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Pervasive Capability Degradation (PCD) refers to the phenomenon in which supervised fine-tuning (SFT), while adapting a large language model (LLM) to a target task, often erodes the general capabilities acquired during pre-training. Prevailing explanations attribute PCD to macroscopic distribution shift and therefore lack microscopic manipulability, leaving existing mitigation methods without a complete theoretical foundation. In this paper, we first develop a bottom-up geometric theory of PCD grounded in feature interference under superposit…
items.why_zh: 为 SFT 导致的能力退化提供可操作的微观解释，有望指导更安全的后训练策略。
items.why_en: A manipulable microscopic explanation of SFT-induced degradation could guide safer post-training strategies.

items.title_zh: 综述：面向医疗健康纵向可穿戴传感器数据的计算模型研究进展
items.title_en: A State-of-the-Art Review of Computational Models for Analyzing Longitudinal Wearable Sensor Data in Healthcare
items.summary_zh: 一篇发表于 arXiv 的综述文章系统梳理了用于分析医疗健康领域纵向可穿戴传感器数据的计算模型。可穿戴设备能持续采集行为与生理数据，按月度甚至年度尺度进行长期追踪，有助于识别健康变化的模式与指标，从而推动医疗向预测性、预防性、个性化与参与式（4P）方向发展。文章指出，这类长期、连续、个体化的数据在建模、理解与处理上仍存在挑战，并对现有方法进行了归纳与评述。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2407.21665v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Wearable devices are increasingly used as tools for biomedical research, as the continuous stream of behavioral and physiological data they collect can provide insights about our health in everyday contexts. Long-term tracking, defined in the timescale of months of year, can provide insights of patterns and changes as indicators of health changes. These insights can make medicine and healthcare more predictive, preventive, personalized, and participative (The 4P's). However, the challenges in modeling, understanding and processing longi…
items.why_zh: 长期可穿戴数据是把医疗服务推向预测与预防的关键，而建模方法是其落地瓶颈。
items.why_en: Long-term wearable data could enable more predictive and preventive care, but the modeling methods needed to turn continuous data into clinical insight remain a key bottleneck.

items.title_zh: 带删失半臂反馈的在线预算分配
items.title_en: Online Budget Allocation with Censored Semi-Bandit Feedback
items.summary_zh: 一篇 arXiv 论文研究了 K 个任务上的随机预算分配问题：每一轮学习者选择预算分配向量，任务 k 以由非递减“预算—成功率”曲线 F_k 决定的概率成功，成功时产生均值未知的随机奖励。学习者只能观察到哪些任务成功，并且只有成功时才看到该任务的奖励，这被称为删失半臂反馈。该模型可刻画在众包工作者之间分配报酬、在多渠道投放预算等场景。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2508.05844v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We study a stochastic budget-allocation problem over $K$ tasks. At each round $t$, the learner chooses an allocation $X_t \in \Delta_K$. Task $k$ succeeds with probability $F_k(X_{t,k})$, where $F_1,\dots,F_K$ are nondecreasing budget-to-success curves, and upon success yields a random reward with unknown mean $\mu_k$. The learner observes which tasks succeed, and observes a task's reward only upon success (censored semi-bandit feedback). This model captures, for instance, splitting payments across crowdsourcing workers or distributing…
items.why_zh: 在只能看到成功样本的反馈下做预算分配，是许多在线平台和众包系统的核心决策难题。
items.why_en: Budget allocation with only success-censored feedback is a core decision problem for online platforms and crowdsourcing systems.

items.title_zh: 流行与爵士数据混合比例对风格自适应和弦生成的实证研究
items.title_en: Empirical Study of Pop and Jazz Mix Ratios for Genre-Adaptive Chord Generation
items.summary_zh: 该论文把和弦进行生成作为独立任务，研究在微调中需要保留多少旧领域数据，才能学会新风格且不遗忘旧风格。作者以在流行乐上预训练的 2500 万参数 Music Transformer 为基础（在留出的流行乐测试集上下一 token 预测 top-1 准确率为 84.21%），用全部 1,513 条爵士训练序列进行爵士微调。由于爵士语料比流行语料小两个数量级以上，实验扫描的变量是同时混入的流行乐“复习”数据量（如 0、1K、2K 等），以观察混合比例的影响。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.04998v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: This paper treats chord progression generation as a standalone task and asks how much old-domain data must be retained in fine-tuning to acquire a new genre without forgetting the old. I study jazz fine-tuning of a pop-pretrained 25M-parameter Music Transformer (84.21% top-1 next-token accuracy on a held-out pop test set). The jazz corpus is over two orders of magnitude smaller than the pop corpus, so every run uses all 1,513 jazz training sequences, and the swept variable is the volume of pop "rehearsal" data mixed alongside: 0, 1K, 2.…
items.why_zh: 小语料新风格微调时如何防止灾难性遗忘，是生成模型领域适配的普遍问题。
items.why_en: How to acquire a new style from a much smaller corpus without catastrophic forgetting is a general challenge in domain-adaptive generative modeling.

items.title_zh: 随机学习动力学中信息获取的速度上限
items.title_en: Speed limits for information acquisition in stochastic learning dynamics
items.summary_zh: 该研究把随机梯度下降（SGD）表述为马尔可夫随机过程，并推导出一个“Fisher 信息流速度上限”，用来界定可训练参数获取关于数据生成参数的信息的速率。所得不等式将信息流上界分解为漂移项与噪声项，从信息论角度量化确定性学习动力与 SGD 随机波动各自的作用。这项工作为理解神经网络学习过程中内部表征的形成速度提供了理论工具。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.08219v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Neural networks acquire internal representations through learning. In this work, we formulate stochastic gradient descent (SGD) as a Markovian stochastic process and derive a Fisher-information flow speed limit that bounds the rate at which trainable parameters can acquire information about data-generating parameters. The resulting inequality decomposes the upper bound on the information flow into drift and noise contributions, thereby quantifying the roles of deterministic learning forces and SGD-induced fluctuations from an informatio…
items.why_zh: 给 SGD 学习过程加上信息获取的“速度上限”，有助于从理论上解释神经网络表征学习的速度与限制。
items.why_en: An information-flow speed limit for SGD offers a theoretical handle on how fast neural networks can form internal representations.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面发布 Kimi Hosted Agents，降低 AI 应用开发运维门槛 ｜#AI资讯# #月之暗面# #智能体开发#
items.title_en: Moonshot AI Releases Kimi Hosted Agents to Lower AI App Development and Operations Barriers
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面发布 Kimi Hosted Agents，降低 AI 应用开发运维门槛 ｜#AI资讯# #月之暗面# #智能体开发# 搜狐网
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI has released Kimi Hosted Agents, a hosted agent offering aimed at lowering the barriers to developing and operating AI applications, according to Sohu. The report did not disclose technical architecture, pricing or availability details.
items.why_zh: 托管式智能体服务若成熟，可让开发者少管基础设施、更快把 AI 应用推向使用。
items.why_en: Hosted agent services can reduce infrastructure work for developers and speed up deployment of AI applications.

items.title_zh: 小鹏研究人员与学术伙伴推出面向物理 AI 的开源视觉感知模型 GroundingPI
items.title_en: XPENG Researchers and Academic Partners Introduce GroundingPI, An Open-Source Visual Perception Model For Physical AI
items.summary_zh: 据 CleanTechnica 报道，小鹏汽车（XPENG）的研究人员与学术合作伙伴共同推出名为 GroundingPI 的开源视觉感知模型，面向物理 AI（Physical AI）场景。该报道将其定位为用于物理世界智能体的视觉感知基础模型，但未在摘要中给出模型架构、训练数据、基准表现或许可证等具体信息。
items.summary_en: XPENG Researchers and Academic Partners Introduce GroundingPI, An Open-Source Visual Perception Model For Physical AI CleanTechnica
items.why_zh: 车企与研究机构开源物理 AI 视觉感知模型，可能推动机器人、自动驾驶等具身智能系统的感知能力共享与迭代。
items.why_en: An open-source perception model for physical AI from an automaker and academic partners could support embodied AI systems such as robots and autonomous driving.

items.title_zh: 月之暗面放大招！Kimi Hosted Agents 正式发布
items.title_en: Moonshot AI Officially Launches Kimi Hosted Agents
items.summary_zh: 月之暗面放大招！Kimi Hosted Agents 正式发布 AIBase
items.summary_en: AIBase reports that Moonshot AI has officially launched Kimi Hosted Agents, positioned around agent development and lowering the barriers to building and operating AI applications. Public details on capabilities, access and commercialization remain limited.
items.why_zh: 这是月之暗面在智能体平台层的重要产品动作，反映大模型厂商向“托管式智能体”服务延伸。
items.why_en: The launch signals Moonshot AI's push into hosted agent services, extending from models to application infrastructure.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 在 Claude 中推出个人理财功能，可连接银行账户获取资金洞察
items.title_en: Anthropic launches personal finance feature in Claude, lets users connect bank accounts for money insight
items.summary_zh: 据《印度时报》报道，Anthropic 在其 AI 助手 Claude 中上线个人理财功能，允许用户连接银行账户，以获得与个人资金相关的洞察。该功能意味着 Claude 可以在用户授权连接账户后，结合财务数据提供分析或建议。报道未披露支持范围、合作银行、数据隐私与安全机制以及收费安排等细节。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launches personal finance feature in Claude, lets users connect bank accounts for money insight The Times of India
items.why_zh: 把银行账户数据接入通用 AI 助手，意味着大模型正进入高度敏感的个人金融场景，隐私与安全将成为关键。
items.why_en: Connecting bank accounts to a general-purpose AI assistant brings LLMs into highly sensitive personal finance, making privacy and security critical.

items.title_zh: DeepSeek 融资低调一笔：16.5 亿元来自一众浙江实业家
items.title_en: DeepSeek quietly raises RMB 1.65 billion from Zhejiang industrialists
items.summary_zh: DeepSeek 融资低调一笔：16.5 亿元来自一众浙江实业家 风闻
items.summary_en: DeepSeek has reportedly raised RMB 1.65 billion in a low-key funding round, with the capital coming from a group of Zhejiang industrialists. Details such as the round stage, valuation and use of proceeds were not disclosed. The deal points to industrial capital playing a role in funding Chinese AI model developers.
items.why_zh: 在 AI 大模型融资日益高调的背景下，DeepSeek 由浙江实业家注资 16.5 亿元，显示产业资本正成为大模型公司的重要资金来源。
items.why_en: At a time when AI model funding is increasingly high-profile, DeepSeek's RMB 1.65 billion raise from Zhejiang industrialists shows industrial capital is becoming an important funding source for large-model companies.

items.title_zh: 科技股暴跌后，Anthropic IPO 面临 5000 亿美元估值冲击
items.title_en: Anthropic IPO Faces $500 Billion Valuation Hit After Tech Stocks Plunge
items.summary_zh: 据 PYMNTS 报道，科技股大幅下挫使 Anthropic 的 IPO 面临约 5000 亿美元的估值冲击。标题信息显示，市场波动已直接影响到这家 AI 公司的上市估值预期；但现有摘要未提供交易规模、时间表或承销安排等细节。对 AI 一级市场而言，这一动向可能加大后续融资与上市的定价压力。
items.summary_en: Anthropic IPO Faces $500 Billion Valuation Hit After Tech Stocks Plunge PYMNTS.com
items.why_zh: 显示 AI 高估值对科技股波动高度敏感，可能影响后续 AI 公司上市与融资定价。
items.why_en: It shows how sensitive high AI valuations are to tech-stock volatility, with potential implications for future AI IPOs and funding.

items.title_zh: 华为小艺独立 App 上线鸿蒙电脑 AppGallery，小艺 Work 正式版同步推出
items.title_en: Huawei's Xiaoyi Launches Standalone App on HarmonyOS PC AppGallery; Xiaoyi Work Official Version Debuts
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，今日有用户发现，华为小艺独立 App 于 11 月 6 日正式上线鸿蒙电脑应用商店 AppGallery，版本号 11.7.9.300，同步推出小艺 Work 正式版。 此前小艺以系统级智能体形式集成于鸿蒙电脑，此次独立 App 意味着其从系统内置能力转为可独立更新、独立迭代的应用形态。 小艺 Work 功能于 2026 年 9 月开启内测，定位为 AI 工作助理，可接收用户目标后自主拆解任务、安排步骤、调用工具并推进执行。 正式版在鸿蒙电脑端支持一句话交办数据分析、PPT 写作、周报总结等任务，直接生成 Word、PPT、Excel 等可用文档。 官方信息显示，小艺 Work 汇聚 200 余位领域专家及专家团，通过连接器打通钉钉、飞书等常用办公工具。其执行环境支持云电脑与本地电脑，用户离开电脑后可通过鸿蒙手机远程下发任务并查看进度。 本次更新还覆盖手机与平板端的三项功能调整。小艺深度解题新增作文本功能，支持 AI 润色作文并一键收藏；错题本中的“举一反三练”扩展至多学科；作业批改的识别能力同步优化，官方称带图题型的批改准确率有所提升。 另外，小艺翻译首页完成改版，新增字幕翻译，拍照翻译支持变焦操作，文本翻译的语音输入可自动识别 21 个语种，无需手动切换。小艺时光机新增对华为 AI 眼镜的支持，可记录眼镜拍摄的瞬间。 IT之家注：小艺 Work…
items.summary_en: On Nov 6, Huawei launched a standalone Xiaoyi app on HarmonyOS PC AppGallery (v11.7.9.300) and released the official Xiaoyi Work version. The move turns Xiaoyi from a system-level agent into an independently updated app; Xiaoyi Work can break down tasks, call tools and generate Word, PPT and Excel files from a single instruction. Huawei says it connects with DingTalk and Feishu and supports remote task assignment from HarmonyOS phones.
items.why_zh: 小艺从系统内置能力转为独立应用，显示华为正把 AI 智能体打造成可独立迭代的核心生产力入口。
items.why_en: Xiaoyi becoming a standalone app shows Huawei is positioning its AI agent as a core, independently iterated productivity gateway.

items.title_zh: Meta 给 AI 装上“脸”和“嗓子”：Muse 现在能视频聊天了
items.title_en: Meta Gives AI a Face and Voice: Muse Now Supports Video Chat
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，Meta 首席执行官马克 · 扎克伯格（Mark Zuckerberg）今天（11 月 6 日）在 Threads 社交平台上发布串文 ，宣布个人 AI 助手 Muse 正式上线实时语音对话与富有表现力的虚拟形象功能。 上述功能率先面向美国用户推送，覆盖移动端、网页端和 Mac 应用。用户点击应用右上角的电话图标，即可像打电话一样与 Muse 交谈，并可在其回答过程中随时打断。IT之家附上相关截图如下： 在技术支撑方面，本次更新主要由 Muse Realtime Voice 语音模型和 Muse Realtime Avatar 虚拟形象模型提供支持，前者会同时生成“说什么”和“怎么说”的信息；而后者基于同一数据流实时生成表情、口型和肢体动作，让声音与画面保持同步。 Meta 称，该系统可流式输出 448×768 分辨率、25 帧每秒的竖屏视频，从用户说完话到收到首个音视频响应的延迟约为 870 毫秒。 在交互方式上，用户可选择仅语音、在聊天界面旁显示虚拟形象，或切换至全屏“面对面”模式。Muse 的默认形象是昵称为“Jolly”的卡通角色，用户也可将其替换为人物、动物或其他角色；语音方面提供数百种风格，包括“纽约客式活力”和“海盗风”等。 Meta 将这一能力定位为更自然的个人智能体交互：用户可以在散步、双手忙碌时口头安排任务，Muse 则在后台继续…
items.summary_en: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg announced that the personal AI assistant Muse now supports real-time voice conversation and expressive avatars, rolling out first to US users on mobile, web and Mac. Users can tap a phone icon to talk to Muse, interrupt its answers, and choose voice-only, side-avatar or full-screen face-to-face modes. The system streams 448×768 portrait video at 25 fps with about 870 ms latency to the first audio-video response.
items.why_zh: 把语音、虚拟形象和低延迟交互结合，意味着个人 AI 助手正从文字对话走向更自然的多模态陪伴与任务执行。
items.why_en: Combining voice, avatars and low-latency interaction moves personal AI assistants from text chat toward more natural multimodal companionship and task execution.

items.title_zh: Dropbox 以 3.5 亿美元收购 Tigris Data，并发布新 AI 生产力功能
items.title_en: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M, releases new AI productivity features
items.summary_zh: 据 SiliconANGLE 报道，Dropbox 以 3.5 亿美元收购 Tigris Data，并同步发布新的 AI 生产力功能。报道标题显示，这两项动作同时公布，但现有摘要未披露 Tigris Data 的技术细节、整合计划以及新 AI 功能的具体清单。交易金额为 3.5 亿美元；报道未说明收购原因和整合细节。此举显示 Dropbox 在发布 AI 生产力功能的同时，继续通过并购扩展能力。
items.summary_en: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M, releases new AI productivity features SiliconANGLE
items.why_zh: 在 AI 生产力功能发布的同时进行并购，显示 Dropbox 正通过外延式收购补强能力以应对协作软件竞争。
items.why_en: Pairing an acquisition with AI productivity releases signals Dropbox is using M&A to strengthen its capabilities amid collaboration-software competition.

items.title_zh: 工信部加强智能体终端设备进网管理，规范终端与智能体适配
items.title_en: China's MIIT Tightens Network Access Management for Agent Terminals, Standardizes Device-Agent Adaptation
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，工信部今日发布关于加强智能体终端设备进网管理的通知，其中提到开展智能体和终端适配、改进智能体终端进网管理、强化智能体现网升级管理、健全智能体分发管理机制四大工作任务。 IT之家整理四大工作任务如下： （一） 开展智能体和终端适配。 智能体是具备自主感知、记忆、决策、交互与执行能力的智能系统。智能体开发者应加强与终端设备的适配验证，强化权限调用、通信能力、网络与数据安全、用户权益和任务执行等方面管理，确保符合监管要求和用户预期，保障智能体兼容稳定运行。智能体开发者应规范智能体信息管理，在产品设置页面向用户公示适配验证列表，列明已完成适配的终端型号以及操作系统信息，保障用户知情权和选择权。智能体在应用分发平台上架前，其开发者应向应用分发平台提交适配验证情况。 （二） 改进智能体终端进网管理。 开展风险评估，完善电信设备进网检测机制，细化特别规定事项要求。预置智能体的手机、平板、可穿戴设备等智能体终端，须在进网检测中依据有关标准开展智能体适配验证；依法开展智能体终端涉诈风险安全评估和反诈能力前置性评测，落实重要通信工作要求。终端上使用的智能体应参考智能体互联系列国家标准配备唯一身份码。终端生产企业应当保证智能体终端获得进网许可证前后的一致性。智能体终端发生重大变化的，终端生产企业应当向工业和信息化部报备，并按要求开展进网检测。 （三） 强化智能体现网升级管…
items.summary_en: China’s MIIT issued a notice on strengthening network access management for agent terminals, setting out four tasks covering device-agent adaptation, access management, upgrade management and distribution. Agent developers must strengthen adaptation testing, disclose compatible device models and OS information, and submit adaptation results before listing on app stores. Devices with preinstalled agents must undergo adaptation verification during network access testing, and agents should carry unique ID codes under national standards.
items.why_zh: 这是针对 AI 智能体终端的分发、进网与升级管理规则，可能影响手机、平板和可穿戴设备上的智能体预置与上架流程。
items.why_en: The rules target distribution, network access and upgrades for AI agent terminals, potentially affecting how agents are preinstalled and listed on phones, tablets and wearables.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Cyber：强化漏洞利用研究，API 价格高于 Anthropic 和 Google

items.title_zh: 京东物流“狼族”机器人升级：智狼取货提速、保姆狼实现无人分拣
items.title_en: JD Logistics Upgrades Its "Wolf Pack" Robots: Smarter Picking and Unmanned Sorting
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，11 月 5 日，在 2026 年 CeMAT ASIA 亚洲国际物流技术与运输系统展览会上，京东物流携全新升级的“狼族”机器人亮相， 推出“智狼”“保姆狼”全新升级方案。 “狼族”是京东物流自研的 具身机器人军团 ，覆盖仓储、分拣、运输、配送全链路。其包含“智狼”“保姆狼”“异狼”“ 飞 狼 ”等 9 款产品、11 款机器人，在“超脑”大模型调度下协同作业。其中，“智狼”和“保姆狼”处在仓储拣选与分播两个关键节点，已在全球规模化部署，在本次展会全新升级亮相。 IT之家从官方介绍获悉， “智狼”是货到人解决方案，解决传统仓库存储密度不足及“人找货”效率低的问题 。“智狼”飞梯机器人从 12 米高的货架取箱，再由“智狼”搬运机器人送至拣选站，人只需在站内拣选，不用在货架间穿行。该方案已在全球超 100 个仓库规模化落地，存储效率较传统提升 600%，出库效率提升 300%。 此次“智狼”升级，集中在结构创新与供电方式。京东物流 首创“旋转式取货平台” ，简化“先钩取再传送”的取放货步骤，实现一次钩取到位，单台设备每小时作业次数可突破 240 次，相当于每 15 秒完成一次取货，动作效率进一步提升 30%；旋转式平台突破性采用双深位存储方案，存储能力提升 20%。此外， 升级版“智狼”采用无线供电 ，取消了物理接触，避免 滑触线 磨损，实现供电系统零维护…
items.summary_en: At CeMAT ASIA 2026, JD Logistics unveiled upgraded "Wolf Pack" embodied robots, including the "Smart Wolf" goods-to-person picking system and the "Nanny Wolf" sorting robot. Smart Wolf, already deployed in over 100 warehouses worldwide, adds a rotating pick platform and wireless power, boosting throughput and storage density.
items.why_zh: 这是大模型调度与具身机器人结合在仓储物流规模化落地的代表性案例。
items.why_en: It shows embodied robots orchestrated by large models reaching large-scale deployment in warehousing and logistics.

items.title_zh: Hugging Face CEO 称 AI“末日风险”接近于零，真正危险来自闭门造车
items.title_en: Hugging Face CEO Says AI Doom Risk Is Near Zero, Warns of Closed Development
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，当地时间昨日（11 月 5 日）在美国迈阿密举行的 WIRED 世界博览会上，开源 AI 平台 Hugging Face 首席执行官克莱门特 · 德朗格（Clément Delangue）表示， 他对人工智能导致人类灭绝的概率（即 P (Doom)）评估“接近于零”。 他认为，相比“AI 毁灭世界”的宏大担忧，更现实的风险是少数大公司在封闭环境中秘密开发前沿模型。德朗格称，AI 的主要风险并非来自开放生态，而是“少数闭门造车的参与者”。 他主张，降低风险的关键是让更多开发者能够公开构建、审查和改进模型，从而形成相互制衡的生态系统。在他看来，开放权重模型不仅是技术选择，也是防止少数企业垄断人才、算力与 AI 能力的手段。 德朗格还透露，Hugging Face 目前的 AI 开发者已超过 2,000 万，较英伟达今年 9 月宣布以 129.3 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 864.42 亿元人民币） 收购该公司时公布的约 1,800 万用户继续增长。该公司还已售出 5 万台可通过 AI 编程的双足机器人 Microducks。
items.summary_en: Speaking at WIRED's event in Miami, Hugging Face CEO Clément Delangue put the probability of AI-driven human extinction near zero, arguing the real risk comes from a few companies developing frontier models behind closed doors. He said Hugging Face now has over 20 million AI developers.
items.why_zh: 开源阵营与“AI 末日论”的正面交锋，将 AI 治理争论的焦点从存在性风险转向开放与垄断。
items.why_en: It reframes the AI safety debate from existential risk toward openness versus concentration of power.

items.title_zh: 蚂蚁百灵大模型 Ling 3.2 Flash 发布：三项基准超越 Claude Opus 5，前两周限时免费
items.title_en: Ant Group's Ling 3.2 Flash Debuts, Beating Claude Opus 5 on Three Benchmarks
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 6 日消息，蚂蚁百灵官方团队今日宣布推出原生多模态模型 Ling-3.2-flash，拥有 560B 总参数、25B 激活参数、1M 上下文窗口。 该模型从架构层面原生融合视觉与语言能力，支持图像、文本与视频输入，重点强化复杂视觉理解、多模态长程 Agent、3D 理解与交互、医疗多模态四大能力。 在蚂蚁官方公布的评测结果中，Ling-3.2-flash 在三项基准上超过 Anthropic Claude Opus 5（max）： OmniDocBench1.5 得分 92.21，对比 90.56； ZEROBench（Sub）得分 43.71，对比 39.52； Vision2Web 得分 85.86，对比 80.20。 在 DesignArena 图像转前端竞技场中，该模型以 1238 的 Elo 分数进入前十，与 Meta、DeepSeek 及 Anthropic 等竞品并列。 该模型重点强化四大能力：复杂视觉理解面向图像与视频的深度推理与分析；多模态长程 Agent 要求在多步任务中持续保持目标一致，基于视觉与文本信息完成决策与执行；3D 理解与交互侧重三维场景与空间关系的解析；医疗多模态则覆盖医学影像理解与报告解读，辅助专业医疗分析。 据介绍，560B 总参数与约 25B 激活参数的组合，是 Ling-3.2-flash 在能力与推理开销之间的核心权衡…
items.summary_en: Ant Group's Ling team released Ling-3.2-flash, a natively multimodal model with 560B total and about 25B active parameters and a 1M context window. It tops Claude Opus 5 (max) on three official benchmarks and focuses on visual reasoning, long-horizon multimodal agents, 3D understanding and medical multimodal tasks.
items.why_zh: 国产开源路线的大模型在文档、视觉与前端生成等基准上正面对标国际旗舰产品。
items.why_en: Chinese models are now benchmarking head-to-head with top international flagship models in vision-heavy tasks.
